# fuel 200000/2000, identical DCERT1 certificate bytes by sha256, 8 GiB guard.

# GENERATION OK is NOT a benchmark pass: no reference stimuli, no trace, no
# control interpreter.  The artifact is an in-memory Program; nothing is
# serialized.  Rows that refuse stay IN the denominator.
